title: Kaininja: Extending Native 3D Generators to the Part Level
abstract: arXiv:2609.15659v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Native 3D generators turn one image into a single mesh. TRELLIS.2 and its peers deliver high-fidelity non-watertight geometry with materials, but the output is one fused object, while downstream work such as editing, rigging and simulation operates on part-level assets. A naive idea is to run a 3D segmentation network on the fused mesh that TRELLIS.2 generates, but such pipelines are slow and bounded by the accuracy of the segmentation. We want a simple way to extend an existing native 3D generator to the part level. But we face a critical problem: the O-Voxel grid stores one sheet of surface per voxel, so a single volume cannot represent the interface where two parts touch, at any resolution. We introduce a dual-volume representation to solve this problem and put forward KaiNinja, a part-level extension of TRELLIS.2 built on a dual-volume form of its O-Voxel representation. KaiNinja keeps the generation speed and quality of TRELLIS.2

translated_title: KaiNinja：将原生3D生成器扩展到部件级别
translated_abstract: 原生3D生成器可以将单张图像转化为一个网格。TRELLIS.2及其同类方法能够生成带材质的高保真非水密几何体，但其输出是一个融合的整体对象，而诸如编辑、骨骼绑定和仿真等下游任务需要操作的是部件级别的资产。一种直观的做法是在TRELLIS.2生成的融合网格上运行3D分割网络，但这类流水线速度慢且受限于分割精度。我们希望找到一种简单的方法将现有的原生3D生成器扩展到部件级别。但我们面临一个关键问题：O-Voxel网格在每个体素中只存储一层表面，因此无论分辨率多高，单一体积都无法表示两个部件相接触的界面。我们引入了一种双体积表示来解决这一问题，并提出了KaiNinja——一个基于TRELLIS.2的O-Voxel表示的双体积形式构建的部件级扩展。KaiNinja保持了TRELLIS.2的生成速度和质量。
tldr: KaiNinja针对O-Voxel表示无法表达部件间接触界面的关键限制，提出双体积表示方法，将原生3D生成器TRELLIS.2扩展到部件级别，且不牺牲其生成速度与质量。
en_tdlr: KaiNinja extends the native 3D generator TRELLIS.2 to the part level by introducing a dual-volume representation that overcomes the inability of O-Voxel grids to model interfaces where two parts touch, while preserving generation speed and quality.
